name: Dubai Waste Management Centre (Warsan), United Arab Emirates
description: world's largest waste-to-energy plant: processes 1.9 million tonnes of waste a year, powers about 135,000 homes; about USD 1 bn project; began transmitting electricity July 2023

sources.note: AGBI, 19 Jul 2023 (start of electricity transmission, 1.9 Mt/yr, USD 1 bn); FM Middle East, 13 Sep 2022 (world's largest WTE, 135,000 homes); read 2026-10-28
